0022600211.text: The Knicks host the Milwaukee Bucks in New York's 10th game of the season, with the Knicks at 5-4 on a three-game winning streak and 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, while the Bucks are 1-9 on a six-game losing streak and 5th in the Central. Josh Hart is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision for New York, while Milwaukee's Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise) are also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
